Scope: Official publisher page and retained archive follow-up for NTCore Driver List and Rebel.NET; no payload extraction or execution

Products.Name: Driver List
PublisherClaims: Can generate a report file from the list
Products.PriorStaticFinding: Embedded version was not verified; IA64 is Itanium, not ARM64 or x64.
Products.LicenseDisposition: No explicit product-specific use or redistribution grant is present in the reviewed page or retained archive evidence. Do not infer permission from other NTCore products.
Remaining: Resolve product-specific usage and distribution rights
Verify embedded versions and exact architecture compatibility
Treat generated driver inventory as potentially sensitive output
Defer loaded-driver and report behavior checks to an isolated registered guest

Products.Name: Rebel.NET
PublisherClaims: Creates Rebel.NET report files from .NET assemblies and rebuilds assemblies from report files, adding or replacing methods and streams
Supports command-line report and rebuild operations
The publisher describes it as a research project and says commercial use goes against its licensing terms
The guide documents a format flag that can delete all methods in the original assembly; it advises that this is rarely useful
Products.LicenseDisposition: Commercial use is expressly prohibited by the guide's licensing statement. No explicit redistribution grant or full license text was found in the reviewed guide, page, or archive evidence; user-specific noncommercial eligibility remains unassessed.
Remaining: Resolve applicable user scope and any redistribution rights from the publisher or exact license text
Use only owned synthetic assemblies and separate output paths in any later acceptance
Verify byte-exact input preservation, signing/strong-name effects, failure recovery and report/rebuild behavior
Defer execution to an isolated registered guest; do not use protected third-party assemblies

EstimateReason: The Rebel.NET guide resolves a commercial-use restriction and documents destructive rebuild capability, but intended scope, redistribution, all runtime behavior and both complete legacy outcomes remain unresolved. Driver List rights and output privacy also remain open.
